newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Voltek sees Q1 loss, sets buyback.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Voltek sees Q1 loss, sets buyback.

text.p: Thermo Voltek Corp on Tuesday said it expects to report a "small" loss for the first quarter ended March 29 when it announces its results on May 2.
It also said it anticipates reporting revenues for the quarter of about $9.7 million.
One year ago, the electronics firm reported first quarter income of $0.18 per share on revenues of $10.6 million.

Thermo Voltek, an affiliate of Thermedics Inc, in turn a Thermo Electron Corp affiliate, said sales of its electromagnetic compatibility test equipment slowed in the first quarter, as many companies had previously completed equipment purchases to comply with IEC 801, the European Union Directive regarding electromagnetic interference.
Separately, the firm said it it will repurchase, through April 14, 1998, up to $5 million of its own securities in the open market, or in negotiated transactions..
Also, Thermo Voltek said that it has acquired $3.2 million Milmega Ltd, a private firm that designs and manufactures microwave and radio frequency (RF) power amplifiers and other RF products.
Milmega, based on the Isle of Wight, in the United Kingdom, had revenues of $2.1 million for the fiscal year ended October 31, 1996, the company said.
